attchmntText: TCC Concept Limited has informed the Exchange about giving Corporate Guarantee for Pepperfry Limited.
desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
voiceSummary: TCC Concept Limited has extended a corporate guarantee towards an Overdraft facility availed by its material subsidiary, Pepperfry Limited. The guarantee is issued in favor of ICICI Bank Limited to secure credit facilities aggregating to 30 crore rupees sanctioned to Pepperfry Limited. This amount comprises an Overdraft facility of 30.00 crore rupees, which includes a Working Capital Demand Loan sub-limit and a Bank Guarantee facility of 17.50 crore rupees. The facilities are intended to meet Pepperfry Limited's working capital requirements and permitted financial and performance guarantee requirements. The promoter group does not have any interest in this transaction, and the guarantee has been provided on an arm's length basis. The corporate guarantee will be treated as a contingent liability for TCC Concept Limited.

attchmntText: TCC Concept Limited has informed the Exchange about Shareholders meeting
voiceSummary: TCC Concept Limited has passed an ordinary resolution to approve material related party transactions. The remote e-voting period ran from October 10, 2026, to November 8, 2026. The scrutinizer report dated November 9, 2026, confirms the resolution was approved with a requisite majority. Fifty-six members voted in favor, casting 5,41,72,028 votes, representing 99.95 percent of valid votes. Three members voted against, casting 28,150 votes. No votes were declared invalid. The resolution is deemed passed on November 8, 2026. The voting results and scrutinizer report are available on the company website at www.tccltd.in.
